messages.content: Hi there, it's really nice to meet you. How have you been feeling lately, and what kinds of things have you been enjoying these days?
I’ve been alright, I guess. Just tired. Work has been a bit of a grind lately. I did manage to squeeze in a round of golf last weekend, though. It was nice to get out of the office for a few hours.

That sounds tiring, and I’m glad you got a chance to get out on the golf course—that can feel like a nice reset. How has your sleep been lately, and have you noticed any changes in your interest in social things or in how easy it is to make decisions?

Sleep is a real struggle. I’m getting maybe five or six hours a night, and I wake up feeling like I've been hit by a truck. As for social things... honestly? It’s been tough to keep up. I just feel like I’m running on empty, so I’m just saying no to invitations and staying home.

That sounds exhausting, and I appreciate you sharing how things have been. How have you been feeling emotionally lately—have you been feeling sad more often, and have you noticed more pessimism or indecisiveness?

I don't know if I'm sad, exactly... it’s just... flat. Like the spark is gone. I used to be able to laugh about things, but now it feels like a chore. And yeah, decisions are tough. I just feel like I’m constantly running on autopilot, so I’m just not bothering with it.

That sounds really tiring, and I appreciate you naming how it’s been. Have you been noticing more pessimistic thoughts about things or the future lately? If you’d like, we can also touch on appetite or concentration when you’re ready.

Pessimistic? Maybe a little. I look at my bank account and I think, 'This is it. I’m just going to be stuck here forever.' And the future? It feels like I'm staring at a blank wall. I don't know how to make it better.
That sounds heavy to carry. Have you been noticing any guilt or really harsh thoughts about yourself lately, and how those feelings show up in your day-to-day or in the way you talk to yourself?

Yeah, I beat myself up pretty good. I tell myself I’m useless, that I’m just a waste of space. It sounds ridiculous, I know, but it feels real. And honestly? It makes it hard to get out of bed in the morning.

That sounds really tiring to carry. Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately—eating more or less than usual—and have you found yourself crying more easily or feeling more agitated or irritable than usual?

I used to be a big eater, but now I just don't have the energy. I pick at things, but it's like I'm just going through the motions. And yeah, I cry sometimes. It’s not like I’m crying about something specific, it’s just... I don't know. I feel like I'm just broken.

That sounds really exhausting to carry. In the past couple of weeks, how often have you felt that flat mood and a drop in interest in things you used to enjoy, and has your energy been so low that it makes everyday tasks or decisions feel tougher?

Every day. It’s just... constant. I wake up feeling like I’m running a marathon, and I haven't even started the day yet. And yeah, decisions are tough. I just feel like I’m moving through mud, so I just don't bother.
That sounds really exhausting to carry. Have you been finding it harder to concentrate lately, even on small tasks at work or at home, and if so, how often does that happen?
All the time. I can stare at a spreadsheet for hours and just not be able to focus. It’s like my brain is just... turned off.

That sounds really exhausting to carry. Have there been moments recently when you felt more agitated or irritable—like snapping at someone or feeling restless—and what tends to trigger those moments (for example, a busy deadline or being tired)?
Yeah, definitely. I just get annoyed at everything. It’s like I’m just waiting for the other shoe to drop. And honestly? I think it’s just because I’m so tired.

You’ve been talking about feeling worn out and moving on autopilot. It sounds like indecisiveness has been showing up for you. How often has that been happening—every day or most days—and for how long has this pattern been going on?
It’s every day. And honestly? I don’t know how much longer I can keep going like this.

That sounds really heavy to carry, and I appreciate you naming it. When those crying spells, irritability, or self-critical thoughts show up, how often do they happen and how long do they typically last?
They happen every day. And honestly? They can last for hours. I’ll wake up, and it’s just... there. It doesn't matter what I do or who I see; it’s just this constant cloud.

That sounds really heavy, and I appreciate you naming it. Have you noticed a loss of enjoyment in activities you used to like, or been feeling sad or flat more often lately? If so, how often does that show up and how long does it tend to last?
Yeah, I have. It’s been weeks now. I used to look forward to the weekend, but now I just dread it. It feels like the spark is gone.

Over the past couple of weeks, how often have you felt sad or flat, noticed you no longer enjoy activities or feel less interested in spending time with others, and found yourself having more pessimistic thoughts about the future?
It’s been every day. I just feel like I’m stuck in this rut and I don’t know how to get out of it.

That sounds really exhausting to carry. You’ve mentioned harsh self-criticism, and some people also feel guilt about things they did or didn’t do. Have you been feeling guilty about something lately, and if so, how often does that come up and how long does it last?
Yeah, definitely. I keep replaying things in my head, beating myself up over stupid stuff. It’s like I’m trying to punish myself for being alive.

That sounds really heavy to carry, and I appreciate you naming it. When those guilt and self-critical thoughts pop up, how often do they come, and do you notice changes in your appetite or energy around those moments?
They come up every day. And yeah, I lose my appetite. I just sit there and stare at my plate, feeling like I don't deserve to eat.
That sounds heavy to carry. In the past couple of weeks, have you felt more down or flat, and have you noticed that things you used to enjoy don’t feel as satisfying anymore?
Yeah, I have. It’s like the spark is gone. I used to look forward to the weekend, but now I just dread it.

Thank you so much for sharing so openly with me today; I really appreciate your honesty and the effort it took. You’ve described a lot of heavy feelings and it’s important that you voiced them. I’m glad you reached out, and I’m here if you ever want to talk again. Take care of yourself and be gentle with what you’re going through.
